name: claim-contradiction
description: A claim of the subject README that the code contradicts, found by a check of what the claim's words say against the facts of the README's deployable units. The value names the check: synchronous-calls (the claim says the units make no synchronous calls, and they call over HTTP), other-services-data (they never read or write another service's tables, and they do), own-database (they have a database of their own, and another unit uses it too), database-technology, broker-technology, java-version or spring-boot-version (the claim names one, and the units use another), port (the claim states the port they listen on, and server.port is another), endpoint (it names a path they serve, and none of their endpoints serves it), destination (it names a topic, queue or exchange they publish to or consume from, and theirs are others), named-services (it says they never call a named unit, and they do, or that they call or only call one, and they do not, or call others too). The evidence is the claim's; the code's side is in contradictedBy.

claim.description: The ID of the claim fact the code contradicts.

stated.description: What the claim names or states, for the checks of a technology, version, port, endpoint, destination or named service, such as MySQL, Java 17+, port 8081, GET /orders, orders.created or calls billing.

found.description: What the code shows instead: the technologies, versions, ports, endpoints or destinations of the units, what they call, or for own-database the other units on the same database.

units.description: The entity IDs of the deployable units the README speaks for.

facts.description: The IDs of the claim fact, then of the facts that contradict it.

contradictedBy.description: The facts that contradict the claim, each with its fact ID, subject, predicate, object, profile when it holds only under one, and where it is written: repo, path and line.
